The promise now fails for a legitimate, retained result. Whole-population measurement at the supersede checkpoint `19d9e085a4523fdbe86dc5963d227d3ddc246d79` found 164 direct `C-*` archive directories — including the predecessor archived as `superseded` — one live attempt-pair finding, and zero retired-code findings. The current full review has an unchanged historical tail of `review.confidently-wrong` findings on other archived bundles; the latest historical bound pass's Ack is bound to that historical snapshot, not to today's different whole snapshot, so it does not clear this finding.
The historical close commit `20b9135b47771b66efebe40709dd7c777936d901` contains exactly 27 archive bundles: the 26 `AUTHORING_ARCHIVE_C_IDS` plus `C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY` itself. This change therefore keeps a frozen zero over the verified historical membership, keeps the retired-code rejection over the complete archive, and adds a post-archive whole-suite criterion so the same gap cannot recur.
